PRINCIPAL direction 2026-06-04: finish THIS round of substrate revisions BEFORE writing the Windows-tester tutorials (tutorials against a moving substrate would be stale). Scope LOCKED to A+B+C; D explicitly DEFERRED to standing backlog (not this round). Done-definition: every A+B+C ticket closed or has a concrete-plan ticket; substrate stable enough that a tutorial written against it stays accurate.

== IN SCOPE ==
A — SUBSTRATE-SHAPE (a tutorial must document these; sequence-critical):
- stoa--3c9  tool-selection discipline (when-to-use-what) — the tutorial IS this; do EARLY
- stoa--yfv epic: .1 verdict threat-coverage assertion (keystone) / .2 threat-anchored probes / .5 floor-manager+close-gate alignment / .6 culture — Arc B threat-defeat DETECTION
- stoa--h2z  critical-issue -> dedicated remediation workflow (needs 3c9 + yfv.1)
- stoa--0hl  team-deploy procedure canon (§5.6) + §4.5 reconciliation — a stand-up-a-team tutorial must match this

B — TESTER-FACING BUGS (block the handoff demo; Windows tester confirmed):
- stoa--wq0  save-verdict Windows git-bash fail (heredoc/-tmp) — HARD blocker, hit during Arc 52
- stoa--7ap  Windows worktree-remove orphan dir
- stoa--7b1.2 save-verdict ships .gitignore (pycache)
- stoa--xxy  save-verdict receipt filename collision
- stoa--x4j  autonomous gauntlet silent-stall on permission prompt (the pre-allowlist fix is now documented in workflow-composer skill — verify/canonize)

C — HYGIENE (clean snapshot before docs):
- stoa--g38  Arc-53 deferred tail (agents.ts resync + 2 stale check.sh cites + [-e] asymmetry)
- stoa--rwp  bw 0.13.1 upgrade
- stoa--2i5  install.sh canonical .gitignore for transient paths

== DEFERRED (NOT this round — standing backlog; tutorials coexist) ==
D: stoa--xyb debloat epic (+.1/.2), stoa--3na (apply canon to other workspaces), stoa--sp1, stoa--tvc, stoa--vr1, stoa--e8m, stoa--7b1.3/.4/.5/.6/.7, accretions stoa--q36/ilt/aox/myd/bbi.

== SUGGESTED SEQUENCE ==
1. C hygiene first (g38/rwp/2i5) — cheap, clears the deck.
2. A substrate-shape: 3c9 (tool-selection) -> yfv Arc B (.1 keystone first) -> h2z. Sequence-critical (h2z needs 3c9+yfv.1).
3. B tester-bugs (the save-verdict cluster wq0/7b1.2/xxy can bundle; 7ap; x4j) — can run parallel to A since different surface.
Then: substrate frozen -> write tutorials.

SCOPE + DRIVE MODE LOCKED (PRINCIPAL 2026-06-04):

1. HANDOFF DECOUPLED FROM THE ROUND. Deadline de-pressurized. The tester-handoff MVP is small: (a) beadwork initialized in her project, (b) an agent that POLLS beadwork + reads its instructions there. Everything else (the full round, polished tutorials) is PUSHED AS UPDATES AFTER, via the forge->shop mechanism (check-substrate-updates + install.sh). She gets a working base + an update pipe; the substrate can keep evolving. So this round finishes on ITS OWN timeline, NOT gated to the handoff date.

2. DRIVE MODE = BATCHED WITH STANDING AUTONOMY (operating-disciplines §13 autonomous; §4.6 autonomous-ship). Boundary:
   - AUTONOMOUS-SHIP on clean PASS: bucket B (tester bugs: wq0/7b1.2/xxy/7ap/x4j) + bucket C (hygiene: g38/rwp/2i5). Non-canon-critical, non-brand surface -> §4.6 permits autonomous commit+close+push.
   - PRINCIPAL-GATED (surface design + ship): bucket A (substrate-canon: 3c9, yfv Arc B, h2z, 0hl). These touch the substrate's 'public API' -> close-gate stays with PRINCIPAL.
   - User-tier POLYBIUS holds close-gate/merge for A; autonomously merges B+C clean-PASS; surfaces only A gates + universal escalation triggers (§11) to PRINCIPAL.

3. SEQUENCING INSIGHT (x4j first): bucket B's stoa--x4j (autonomous gauntlet silently stalls on a permission prompt) is the bug that makes batched-autonomy UNRELIABLE. Fix it EARLY — the pre-allowlist fix is already documented in the workflow-composer skill; canonize it — so the rest of the autonomous batch doesn't silently wedge. Autonomy-reliability before leaning on autonomy.

NEXT: verify the handoff-MVP loop is ready (beadwork-init + polling-agent-reads-instructions) as a SEPARATE small deliverable; run the round batched-autonomous on its own timeline.
